answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 60386 Country: India Title: Kalima Question: Has Laa Ilaha Illalah Muhamadur Rasullah together occurred in the holy Quran? Could you please explain it? Answer ID: 60386 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1286/1266/L=11/1436) It is not available in the holy Quran together, rather the two parts do exist in two separate places.
